title: WPSS/277/2023 of HEM CHANDRA PANDEY Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No.277 of 2023
Hem Chandra Pandey ........Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others .....Respondents
Presence:-
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel along with Mr. Manoj Bhatt,
learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned Standing Counsel for the
State/respondent nos.1 and 3.
Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned counsel for respondent no.2-
Commission.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J. (Oral)

Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. By means of this writ petition, petitioner has
challenged the order dated 24.01.2023, passed by
respondent no.2, annexure-1 to the writ petition, whereby
the candidature of the petitioner was rejected by the
respondent-Commission for the post of Assistant Teacher
L.T. Grade, English as the petitioner was not having a
valid certificate of his category i.e. EWS Category which
was issued after the last date of submission of application
form i.e. 25.03.2021.
3. Facts of the case are that the petitioner
submitted his application form for the post of Assistant
Teacher, L.T. Grade, English in EWS Category pursuant to
the advertisement dated 13.10.2020. While submitting his
candidature as EWS candidate, petitioner applied under
the EWS Category for the said post. Undisputedly, the
petitioner participated in the written examination and was
selected and called for document verification. During the

2
course of the document verification, it was found that
EWS Certificate issued after the last date of submission of
application form i.e. 25.03.2021 was not found credible
and accordingly, the candidature of the petitioner was
rejected. Petitioner feeling aggrieved by the order
impugned is before this Court by way of filing the present
writ petition.
4. Petitioner contended before this Court that the
EWS Category Certificate was issued to the petitioner and
the same was valid till 31.03.2021. The respondent-Commission has wrongly taken the date of validity written
in the EWS Certificate as 31.03.2021 as the date of
issuance, rather the certificate does not contain the date
of its issuance.
5. A counter affidavit has been filed by the
respondent-Commission and in the counter affidavit, the
stand taken by the Commission while rejecting the
candidature of the petitioner has been reiterated.
6. The State/respondent no.3 has filed its counter
affidavit and in para 8 of the counter affidavit, this fact
has been clarified vividly by respondent no.3 that the
certificate was issued to the petitioner on 08.07.2020. In
support of the contention raised by respondent no.3, the
Tehsildar, a statement of the Register maintained in the
Office of Tehsildar is annexed wherein the name of the
petitioner found place at Serial No. 32 of 2020. A reference
may be had from annexure-CA2 to the counter affidavit
filed by the Tehsildar. In the Annexure-CA2, the date of
issuance of EWS Certificate is mentioned which is
08.07.2020.

3
7. It is contended by learned counsel for the
petitioner that the respondent-Commission has wrongly
passed the order whereby the candidature of the petitioner
has been rejected as the date which has been taken by the
Commission as the date of issuance of the certificate was
a date to which date the certificate was valid. The
Tehsildar who issued the certificate has filed a counter
affidavit and in counter affidavit, it has been submitted
with the strength of the document annexed, a statement
of the Register maintained in the Office of Tehsildar, that
the EWS Certificate was issued in favour of the petitioner
on 08.07.2020.
8. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent-Commission stated that in the online application, the
petitioner has himself given the date of issuance of the
EWS Certificate as 16.06.2020, therefore, now it cannot
be believed that the certificate was issued on 08.07.2020.
9. Having heard the rival submission made by
learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record
carefully, I find force in the contention made by learned
counsel for the petitioner which is supported by the
respondent no.3 by filing the counter affidavit. The
certificate which has been issued to the petitioner is
annexed by the petitioner as annexure-7 to the writ
petition and from the very perusal of the certificate, it is
reflected that the same has been valid up to 31.03.2021.
The respondent-Commission has wrongly taken that date
as the date of issuance of the certificate. Annexure CA2
makes it abundantly clear that the EWS Certificate was
issued in favour of petitioner on 08.07.2020. It would have
been a better case in favour of the respondent-Commission had it come with a case that the certificate

4
was issued as per the contention of the petitioner on
16.06.2020, but this is not a case of the respondent-Commission. It would be pertinent to mention at this
stage that Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has kept one
seat of Assistant Teacher (English) vacant for the
petitioner vide order dated 25.02.2023.
10. Accordingly, the order dated 24.01.2023,
passed by respondent no.2, annexure-1 to the writ
petition cannot sustain and the same is liable to be
quashed. The writ petition is allowed. Hence, a writ of
certiorari is issued and the order dated 24.01.2023 passed
by respondent-Commission whereby the candidature of
the petitioner is rejected is hereby quashed. A mandamus
is issued to the respondent-Commission to proceed
further in accordance with law after giving the benefit of
EWS reservation to the petitioner and to recommend his
name for appointment.
11. No order as to costs.
12. All pending applications, if any, stand disposed
of.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.05.2024
AK
